comments: Complaudax runs the audit inside the user's authenticated browser session, which lets it evaluate pages a server-side crawler cannot reach, such as logged-in areas, checkout flows, and staging environments. Detection uses axe-core, bundled unmodified. Automated testing covers part of WCAG; the product pairs it with a manual checklist for the rest.
features: Complaudax is a Chrome extension and SaaS platform that audits web pages for WCAG 2.1 and 2.2 Level AA using axe-core. It runs inside your browser session, so it can check pages behind a login, checkout flows, and staging sites. It tracks issues per client over time and generates conformance reports and accessibility statements. (338 caractères)
title: Complaudax
